headline_item.title_en: IBM announces the Quantum Nighthawk r3, its next-gen processor designed to execute 10,000 quantum operations across 520 qubits to tackle more complex problems (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: IBM推出全新Nighthawk r3量子处理器，并计划于2027年通过互联双芯片实现万次量子操作与千位比特规模
headline_item.event_summary_en: IBM has announced its next-gen Nighthawk r3 quantum processor designed for high-speed, high-precision complex computing. The company plans to scale this by 2027, linking two r3 chips to achieve 10,000 operations across 1,000+ qubits.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】IBM在科技研发领域：发布Nighthawk r3处理器，并公布2027年实现双芯片互联、万次操作及千比特算力的技术路线图。
【起因与机理】旨在解决当前量子计算在复杂运算中精度不足与速度缓慢的工程难题。
【关键数据与实测】该公司明确规划在2027年前将两枚r3芯片整合，届时系统将具备运行10,000次量子操作及驱动超过1,000个量子比特的能力。
【观点态度】旨在提升复杂计算的精度与并行处理能力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] IBM (Quantum computing sector): Announced Nighthawk r3 and a 2027 roadmap to link two chips for 10,000 operations at 1,000+ qubits.
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To overcome existing bottlenecks in speed and accuracy for complex quantum calculations.
[Key Metrics] 4% transfer fidelity, progressing towards the target of 99.
[Perspective & Impact] Aiming to improve precision and parallel computing efficiency.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: IBM在PPT里又给量子计算画了个2027年的大饼，虽然1000个比特听起来很美，但量子公司最擅长的永远是明天会更好。毕竟在量子纠错搞定前，这些芯片距离真正算动点啥，可能也就差了十万八千里吧。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: IBM is busy painting another 2027 roadmap for quantum supremacy, because quantum labs are best at promising a better tomorrow. Until they actually fix error correction, those thousand qubits are essentially just very expensive, very cold silicon decorations.

headlines.title_en: A Startup Wants to Fight AI Bioweapons With AI
headlines.event_summary_zh: 初创公司Radical Numerics推出离线AI防御模型，旨在识别天然与人工合成病原体
headlines.event_summary_en: Radical Numerics, founded by former Stanford researchers, has launched Omnii Defense, an edge AI model. It enables researchers to identify natural and engineered pathogens using only a laptop and USB gene sequencer, functioning entirely offline to address growing biosecurity concerns.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】激进的数字在旧金山初创公司发布会：发布离线病原体检测AI模型Omnii Defense

【关键技术规格】Radical Numerics发布生物安全防御AI。
【观点态度】旨在防范AI辅助生成的生物威胁。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Radical Numerics (San Francisco startup launch): Released Omnii Defense, an offline pathogen-detecting AI model
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To proactively counter potential risks of AI-generated bioweapons
[Key Specification] Radical Numerics launches AI biosecurity tool.
[Perspective & Impact] Aims to mitigate AI-assisted biological threats.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI不仅负责制造威胁，现在还得负责修补漏洞。这属于典型的‘用AI魔法打败AI魔法’，不过希望这套防火墙不是那种按下开关后才发现没联网的装饰品。
headlines.industry_impact_en: AI is now creating the poison and selling the cure simultaneously. It’s the ultimate 'use AI to fight AI' narrative, assuming the firewall actually works better than a glorified offline calculator.

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
